resources.string: Each viewer has their own My list, watched films, ratings, bucket list and Continue watching. Profiles are a convenience, not a lock: anyone at the TV can open any of them, except that leaving a Gentle profile asks for the PIN. The TMDB and Stremio accounts sync with the first profile only. Names stay on this TV.
Hold OK on a profile to rename it, change it or remove it.
A Gentle profile always shows only the gentlest films, as family night does, and none of your own files.
No PIN is set, so anyone can leave this profile. Set a PIN in Settings to hold it.
Remove %1$s? Their lists, watched films and Continue watching are deleted from this TV. This cannot be undone.
